_comment: Authoritative Atlas turret weapon tuning shared by server combat and client presentation. Changing any value is a gameplay change: bump WireCodec.BUILD and ship a matching hosted server release. Barrel tables are keyed by barrel count (1 single, 2 twin, 4 quad); interval is seconds between shots (cannon: reload after the volley), heat is shared heat per shot, jolt is hull velocity change (m/s) per shot at the muzzle and rock is the rocking impulse (rad/s) across the shot.

servo._comment: Traverse/elevation servo rates (rad/s), cannon volley spacing (s), and the hull tilt (rad) beyond which firing adds no further rock, so volleys can never flip the machine.

flamer._comment: Cone half-angle in radians; damage is per pulse to every visible enemy inside the cone.

tesla._comment: Seek cone half-angle (rad) for the primary arc; the chain jumps chain_reach metres for chain_share of the damage.

railgun._comment: Hold to charge for charge_seconds while adding charge_heat_per_second, release a full charge; the slug pierces a second target for pierce_share. interval is the reload after a shot.
